overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Will Mbah, a candidate for State Representative in the 34th Middlesex District. Mbah discussed his legislative experience on the Somerville City Council and his platforms regarding government transparency, affordable housing, and senior support.

items.title: Introduction and Personal Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Will Mbah, who shared his background as an immigrant from Cameroon and his tenure as a Somerville City Councilor.

items.title: Professional and Governing Experience
items.summary: Mbah detailed his municipal experience managing budgets and authoring policies related to housing stability, wage theft, and environmental protection.

items.title: Legislative Transparency and Reform
items.summary: The candidate advocated for reforming state legislative processes to increase public access to committee votes and lobbying disclosures.

items.title: Open Floor Votes and Leadership Structure
items.summary: Mbah expressed support for open floor votes and argued that legislative consensus should be built through deliberation rather than leadership mandates.

items.title: Affordable Housing Strategy
items.summary: Mbah proposed a housing strategy focused on increasing production near transit, protecting tenants from displacement, and expanding homeownership opportunities.

items.title: Leadership Term Limits
items.summary: The candidate stated his support for reasonable term limits for legislative leadership positions to ensure a broader distribution of power.

items.title: Senior Citizen Stability and Services
items.summary: The discussion focused on providing seniors with property tax relief, utility assistance, and expanded transportation options to facilitate aging in place.

items.title: Closing and Contact Information
items.summary: Mbah provided his campaign website and final appeal for votes, while Petrella concluded the program with show distribution and social media details.
